The '''Kaump system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Bruanii sector/Legends|Bruanii sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kaump III]].
